task: Show me Diagnoses & Treatment for Female infertility.
agent_final_answer:
Showed the Mayo Clinic "Female infertility - Diagnosis & treatment" page (mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/female-infertility/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20354313).

DIAGNOSIS - Doctor takes a detailed medical history and physical exam; both partners are evaluated. Fertility tests may include:
- Ovulation testing (at-home LH ovulation prediction kit; blood test for progesterone; checking prolactin)
- Hysterosalpingography (X-ray contrast injected into uterus to check the uterus and fallopian tubes)
- Ovarian reserve testing (blood/imaging tests for egg quality and quantity, especially women older than 35)
- Other hormone testing (ovulatory, thyroid, pituitary hormones)
- Imaging tests (pelvic ultrasound; sonohysterogram/saline infusion sonogram; hysteroscopy)
- Rarely: Laparoscopy and Genetic testing

TREATMENT - Depends on cause, age, how long you've been infertile, and personal preferences:
- Medications to restore fertility (fertility drugs): Clomiphene citrate, Gonadotropins (hMG/FSH and hCG), Metformin, Letrozole (Femara), Bromocriptine. Risks: pregnancy with multiples, ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS), and possible long-term ovarian tumor risk.
- Surgery to restore fertility: Laparoscopic or hysteroscopic surgery; Tubal surgeries (now rare due to IVF success).
- Reproductive assistance: Intrauterine insemination (IUI); Assisted reproductive technology, the most effective being in vitro fertilization (IVF).

The page also includes sections on Coping and support and Preparing for your appointment.
